goal: Make wallet loading, creation, and migration consistently return structured result types
Eliminate mutable out-parameters for errors, warnings, and database status codes
Reduce boilerplate and error-prone handling of wallet initialization failures
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Strong support because it makes result handling more powerful while remaining simple to use (martinus)
Nonblocking objection: allowing Result<bool> is error-prone due to implicit bool conversion (martinus)
Clarified handling of types convertible to bool and Result<optional<T>> (sedited)
